sources.snippet: Project Abstract Queryn is an embedding translation and enrichment engine: given a text chunk and its existing embedding from Model A, it returns the equivalent embedding in Model B's space — without re-embedding the source corpus. It ships as a local program, invoked directly against a customer's own infrastructure and authenticated with credentials — not a hosted HTTP API. The core ...

sources.title: QuerynAi/queryn-adapter-ada-002_to_qwen3-emb-8b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Queryn adapter — ada-002 → qwen3-emb-8b Translates an embedding produced by ada-002 into the embedding space of qwen3-emb-8b, so a corpus already embedded with ada-002 can be served against a qwen3-emb-8b index without re-embedding it. Part of the Queryn embedding-translation engine.

sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen3-Embedding
sources.snippet: The Qwen3 Embedding model series is the latest proprietary model of the Qwen family, specifically designed for text embedding and ranking tasks. Building upon the dense foundational models of the Qwen3 series, it provides a comprehensive range of text embeddings and reranking models in various sizes (0.6B, 4B, and 8B). sources.title: vLLM Embedding Setup | qwenlm/qwen3-vl-embedding | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Model files: Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B or Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B models accessible locally or via Hugging Face GPU memory: Minimum 10GB for 2B model, 24GB for 8B model Python packages: numpy, PIL for image handling The vLLM backend is specifically designed for high-throughput scenarios where you need to process large batches of inputs efficiently.
